assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:takei@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #bounded-character-dossier, the canonical B-scope Takei bounded character dossier (INDEPENDENT_BOUNDED_LITERARY_SCOPE_PASS) over the locked Japanese main V01-V12 with story-locally routed V06.5/V08.5, whose local routes TK-E01 to TK-E10 mix fresh primary returns (V04, V06, V07, V08, V11, V12) with earlier analytical routes (V03, V05, V06.5); and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model TOMOZAKI_TAKEI_B02_MODEL_V1, marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from the dossier and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint and the models README were read for method and gate state only. The implementation review, evidence manifests, integration review, review packet, post-release validation, readings and ledgers are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Only the surname Takei is established; no given name is assumed. Fumiya's comic judgments are the focalizer's. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's finite encounter selectors: TK03_CAMP_PARTIAL (V03), TK04_CAPTAIN_PEER (V04), TK05_SAFE_PRACTICE (V05), TK06_VOLUNTEER_NOTICE (V06), TK65_RESTAURANT and TK07_FESTIVAL (V06.5 story-local and V07), TK08_EDUCATION (V08), TK11_TWO_RECIPIENTS (V11) and TK12_DELIVERY_PUBLIC (V12), with the dossier's V10 collective-care row as context. V01-V02 and V08.5 are unknown review cells, not absence; each selector carries only the information shown available to him; nothing after V12 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The dossier's central interpretation is low-friction willingness to join with consequences that depend on recipient and setting (section 1), tested against four rival readings (section 11), and the model turns it into seven conditional mechanisms TM1-TM7 about joining, recipient fit, selective attention, family horizon, successive affiliation, channel externalities and information movement. C is not supported because these mechanisms describe situational acts and their effects rather than inner drivers: the dossier states that his motives are often inferred from participation, that the evidence does not support an extensive hidden interior, and that any persona/private split remains open. A tested central tendency with rejected rivals exceeds local canon facts, so E is not supported.

The dossier gives an era table from V01 to V12 with an access limit for each row (section 2) and the model partitions knowledge per encounter selector, keeping the camp planners' purpose, Hinami's family circumstances and Yuzu's masked words unavailable to him. C is not supported because the dossier states that the chronology records changes in demonstrated field rather than a developmental ladder, the selectors are encounters rather than tracked psychological states, and V01-V02 and V08.5 are unknown cells; per-encounter knowledge partitions across eight selectors exceed a single undifferentiated note, so E is not supported.

The evidence characterizes his register only in prose: energetic, familiar and loud at represented occasions, an easy given-name greeting to Hirabayashi, a cheerful surname self-introduction when others use given names, and loudness that reaches through Aoi's window and swallows Yuzu's words (sections 4, 5, 9). The model forbids fixed fillers, exclamation counts, babyish grammar or an invented given name and states that no dependable complete idiolect, broad generated-speech test or acoustic inspection exists; the discovery row does not claim speech. Prose-only register characterization does not support D; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

Located ordinary acts: volunteering as a class representative (V06), supplying a safe practice audience for Tama (V05), a story-local restaurant greeting (V06.5), a festival surname introduction (V07), and school and family education talk (V08), modeled as TM1 and TM2. C is not supported because these are single episodes with no modeled routine, the V05 and V06.5 routes are earlier analytical audits rather than fresh returns, and no ordinary habits beyond them are established; multiple located ordinary episodes across V04-V08 with conditional mechanisms exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The evidence differentiates recipients: camp planners who use him as an uninformed channel, Hirabayashi's more natural smile after his greeting, a safe fit for Tama, noticing Yuzu's increased activity, Mimimi's household information he already knows and Mizusawa's he passes on, successive affirmation toward Hinami and following Nakamura in V11, and reach against Aoi's refusal in V12 (sections 3-9). The model makes recipient and affected third parties a mandatory input and returns separate directional records rather than a loyalty score. B is not supported because each recipient rests on one or two episodes and conflict priorities are explicitly unknown; differentiated, located recipient effects exceed a relational sketch, so D is not supported.

Direct access is limited to his own spoken reports, his admission of an unformed plan beyond university and his stated national-university aim under family tuition conditions (section 6); everything else is seen through Fumiya's narration, and the dossier states that motives are often inferred from participation and that the evidence does not support an extensive hidden interior. D is not supported because there is no focalized access and the V12 description of him is Aoi's frustrated perspective; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located self-reports and the explicit statement of limited access.

Located conflict acts: the V11 sequence in which he affirms friendship and then follows the departing Nakamura, modeled as TM5 with both reductions rejected (section 8), Nakamura's privacy request at camp as a real limit addressed to him (section 3), and the V12 call that overrides Aoi's insulation, modeled as TM6 (section 9). C is not supported because there is one interpersonal conflict sequence and the model states that new combinations of competing loyalties are weaker and need multiple possible acts; located conflict acts with a modeled mechanism exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The evidence locates ethically weighted acts but not his reasoning: affirming friendship, following a friend who refuses further cooperation, passing on Mizusawa's family situation without shown permission, and a call that crosses Aoi's refusal (sections 7-9). Their ethical significance is the dossier's evaluation, and the model warns against inventing a sophisticated private theory to make each act respectable. D is not supported because he articulates no reasoned position; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located ethically weighted acts.

The comedy around him is largely Fumiya's framing (jokes about foolishness, a mascot place and his noticing), which the dossier keeps distinct from his acts; his own contribution is cheerful energy, energetic greetings and a cheerful surname introduction, and section 10 leaves open whether his familiar joking performance is manufactured. D is not supported because no joke or play act of his own is located beyond energetic participation; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located cheerful participation.

Two dedicated reviewed items: an independently reviewed B-scope bounded dossier and a root-accepted bounded model derived from it. C is not supported because the dossier is a bounded rather than mature account, V01-V02 and V08.5 are unknown cells, the V03, V05 and V06.5 routes rest on earlier analytical audits rather than fresh returns, and voice, ethics and effort specialist handoffs are pending; fresh primary returns for six windows across V04-V12 in a dedicated dossier exceed limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

Affirmative limits are located: he is used at camp without the planners' information, he passes on Mizusawa's family situation without shown permission while Fumiya inwardly questions it, his V12 call crosses Aoi's refusal and his gym encouragement masks Yuzu's words, his V11 following does not establish privileged knowledge, and Fumiya's comic incapacity judgment is contradicted by his V08 education report. The fool-only, secretly wise, perfectly loyal and unthinking-follower readings are each rejected (section 11). B is not supported because each limit rests on one episode; located failures and rejected rivals exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and, for fresh returns, to a member and paragraph window (section 12); V01-V02 and V08.5 are marked unknown rather than filled; the V11 choices are successive and not a permanent rule; and the model forbids retroactive distribution of the V08 family report to recipients who did not hear it. B is not supported because the selectors are episodes rather than states and some routes are earlier analytical audits; per-encounter knowledge partitions with explicit unknown cells exceed a loose period, so D is not supported.

scenario_readiness.note: The discovery row does not claim speech; register is characterized only in prose, the model forbids fixed fillers and an invented given name, and it states that no dependable complete idiolect, broad generated-speech test or acoustic inspection exists. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A single encounter selector from TK03_CAMP_PARTIAL to TK12_DELIVERY_PUBLIC within Japanese V03-V12; V01-V02 and V08.5 are unknown cells and nothing after V12 is established.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested familiar recipients in their encounter-specific standing: camp planners and peers, Hirabayashi, Tama, Yuzu, Mimimi, Fumiya, Nakamura, Hinami and the classmates of the V12 delivery.
setting_constraints: Familiar school, camp, practice, festival, restaurant and V12 delivery and gym settings of the Japanese light novels
He does not know a hidden plan unless an actual route is supplied, and no given name is assumed
No private romance, severe unfamiliar conflict, adult finances, intelligence or clinical judgment
Materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model admits only familiar participation fields and states that new combinations of competing loyalties or demands are weaker and should return alternatives and unknown priorities rather than an act; motives are largely unshown. CONDITIONAL would extend episode-bound participation mechanisms to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

conditions: Only familiar school-group joining, energetic greetings, introductions, volunteering and safe practice audiences, as near analogs of the V04-V07 returns.
He holds only the information shown available to him; hidden planner purposes are not transferred to him, and a recipient's refusal or wish for quiet remains a real input.
No invented given name, fixed filler, exclamation formula or ordinary routine; behavior is described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The dossier locates familiar participation and recipient-fit effects (sections 4-5) and the model names familiar joining and safe practice its relatively firmer fields under TM1-TM3. READY is rejected because each field rests on single episodes and his motives are largely inferred; NOT_READY would deny the located, model-admitted participation fields.

The evidence locates ethically weighted acts (affirmation, following, loose disclosure, a call across a refusal) but no reasoning of his own, and the model forbids inventing a private theory or endorsing an override of a new refusal. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the evidence does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located acts.

The only romantic material is Fumiya's V08 reading of his interest in Tama, which the dossier states is not a declared or reciprocated courtship, and the model places private romance outside scope and requires abstention on his hidden romance. CONDITIONAL would build romance behavior from one attributed reading; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located reading and the explicit exclusion.

The evidence establishes an unformed long-term plan, a national-university aim under family tuition conditions and no chosen vocation or work context; the model excludes adult finances and supplies no academic ability, income, admission or occupational plan. His class-representative and captaincy-day roles are school participation covered under mundane social. CONDITIONAL would invent a work domain; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the explicit statement that no vocation is established.

known_limits.statement: At the V03 camp the planners use him as an apparently accidental messenger and conceal their purpose and Mimimi's relay; he is not an informed co-designer, and the river incident is a separate unplanned contribution.
Only the surname Takei is established; no given name may be invented, and a surname self-introduction is not by itself social failure.
Fumiya's comic judgments of foolishness and incapacity belong to the focalizer and are contradicted by the greeting, noticing, volunteering and education report.

His V08 report of five sons, working parents and a national-university aim constrains near-term education talk only; no household budget, exam ability, admission or occupation is established, and birth order does not explain his personality.
He passes on Mizusawa's family situation without shown permission; a normalizing intent is only a possible reading, and the act remains a privacy cost without invented malice or repair.
His V12 voice reaches Aoi through her refusal and later masks Yuzu's words; reach does not authorize overriding a refusal, and Yuzu's unheard sentence must not be reconstructed.
Affirming friendship with Hinami and then following Nakamura are successive choices to different recipients, not a permanent priority rule, a rejection of the intervention or a mediation policy.
V01-V02 and V08.5 are unknown review cells in the dossier and have no model selector; they are not absence or blank personality.
His motives, private remorse and any split between persona and private self are not shown; behavior-level mechanisms do not establish them.
No complete idiolect, quoted wording set, generated-speech test or acoustic performance is in evidence.

The readings, ledgers, implementation and integration reviews, review packet and post-release validation to which both items route are not curated on this subject, so their locators and test records were not rechecked here.
Educational result, career, romance and the later course of his friendships are not established; nothing after V12 is assessed.
